dataset.name: SolatNadi Worldwide Major Cities Starter Dataset
dataset.description: Curated starter set of major cities for local city search and coordinate-based prayer-time API requests. Not an exhaustive global gazetteer.
dataset.prayerZonePolicy: No city is marked as having a verified official prayer zone. prayerZone.status=not_verified means coordinates may be used for coordinate-based calculations, but official local schedules/zone mappings have not been validated.

sources.name: GeoNames
sources.use: Recommended authoritative source for building/refreshing a broader city gazetteer and timezone mapping.
sources.attribution: GeoNames geographical database; consult GeoNames terms and attribution requirements before redistributing derived bulk data.

sources.name: World Cities geolocation data by joelacus
sources.use: Reference for a downloadable world city dataset with coordinates and optional timezone metadata.
sources.attribution: World Cities geolocation data; source states data is from GeoNames except separately identified enrichment fields.

sources.name: IANA Time Zone Database
sources.use: Standard timezone identifier system; timezone values in this starter file should be validated against the timezone database bundled with your platform/runtime.

limitations: This is a curated starter dataset, not every city worldwide.
Coordinates are representative city-center points and may not match the user's exact locality.
City coordinates alone do not establish an official prayer timetable or Malaysian JAKIM prayer-zone membership.
Before production release, validate the full dataset and consider generating a larger source-derived file with stable GeoNames IDs.

prayerZone.note: Ordinary city coordinates only; no official prayer zone verified in this dataset.
